verdict.headline: Graph formulation does NOT converge to max|r|<1e-6. It breaks the mesh's median wall on the well-posed vertex subset (med 0.0439 overall; per-surface medians 0.0075-0.079 vs mesh LM plateau median 0.130) but exposes a structural singularity: the strict-h=0 evidence equations are non-Lipschitz/degenerate on the one-signal-dominance band where the surface tilt hits the critical value sqrt(2) (price locally pinned to a single signal; CRRA 1/3-2/3 clearing plateaus). The kernel-h operator regularizes exactly this; the wall is in the problem, not in the mesh bookkeeping.
verdict.deficit_status: not computable at strict h=0 (no converged equilibrium). Reconstruction fidelity verified at warm start: deficit(reconstr H0)=0.2653 vs cube 0.2796 (M=8 logit-linear ladder bias -0.014). Final-H deficit 0.916 reflects p-ladder crossings from independent per-surface partial solves, not an equilibrium quantity.
